name: Spam/Junk — Corrupted headers (mbox import artifact)
comments: Cache.db analysis 2026-08-13: 143 messages have a From header with raw binary/zip
bytes spliced into it (e.g. a genuine 'The Economist' header mangled with an mbox
file path and ZIP magic bytes: '...norepPK\x03\x04...homist.com@unknown>').
This is an mbox-import/header-decoding artifact, not a real sender -- every
corrupted header ends in the literal string '@unknown', which no genuine address
ever contains, so this is a safe, precise match with no allow-guard needed.
